content.short: Purpose driven memecoin on Cardano supporting bird conservation.
content.description:
PERNIS TOKEN is a native asset on the Cardano Blockchain. It is a memecoin, and by virtue of that, it is worth absolutely nothing. Zero value. Zilch. It’s not about the size of the pernis, it is how you use it that counts.

PERNIS is balls-deep in jokes and memes. It is pulling hard from the incredible power and resilience of the Cardano community. But perhaps most importantly, it is aiming to help the cause of not only pernises, but of all birds. And, in case you haven’t already figured it out, PERNIS is not going to the moon, Mars, or Jupiter. This pecker is headed straight for Uranus!
